patch.objective: Querying and analyzing logs in Azure Monitor

sources.cite: Microsoft Learn, Study guide for Exam AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator (skills measured as of October 26, 2023; page last updated 2026-10-30): Manage Azure identities and governance 20-25%, Implement and manage storage 15-20%, Deploy and manage Azure compute resources 20-25%, Implement and manage virtual networking 15-20%, Monitor and maintain Azure resources 10-15%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Bullets quoted there: 'Provision a container by using Azure Container Apps'; 'Perform backup and restore operations by using Azure Backup'; 'Query and analyze logs in Azure Monitor'. The objective wording is the course seed's.

sources.cite: Azure Monitor Logs reference: AppRequests table, last updated 2026-07-28
sources.note: Relevant text: columns DurationMs ('Number of milliseconds it took the application to handle the request'), Success, ResultCode, Name, OperationId and AppRoleName. Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14.

sources.cite: Azure Monitor Logs reference: AppDependencies table, last updated 2026-07-28
sources.note: Relevant text: DurationMs ('Number of milliseconds the dependency call took to complete'), Success, ResultCode, Target ('Target of a dependency call, such as a Web or a SQL server name'), DependencyType, Name, OperationId and AppVersion among the columns. Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14.

sources.cite: Kusto Query Language: percentile(), percentiles() aggregation functions, last updated 2025-03-17
sources.note: Relevant text: syntax 'percentile(expr, percentile)' and 'percentiles(expr, percentiles)'; example 'StormEvents | summarize percentiles(DamageProperty, 5, 50, 95) by State'. Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14. The query results in the scenario are authored data for the case.
